evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: So first starting address is 6512, east hill drive. So you're coming from a townhome almost about 2000 square feet, two stories with three bedrooms, correct? ... And then, you're moving to 5704 trail ridge drive into a 2100 square foot house. One story with three bedrooms, correct?
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Carly typically for home of your size we would recommend doing a virtual walkthrough so it's just like a two-way video call, where you're giving a tour of the home, to show the items that we're gonna move for you, so we can give you a more accurate code and that would take about five to ten minutes.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: would you also need help like, packing up the boxes or is everything going to be boxed and ready?

top_strength: Rep correctly identified the move as a walkthrough-eligible size (2,000 sq ft+), offered the virtual walkthrough in Section 1, and cleanly routed to asynchronous video/inventory methods when the customer couldn't do a live call—showing excellent problem-solving on the core walkthrough logistics.
coaching_note: Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' (Section 2, Their Agenda) before diving into logistics details—you jumped straight to probing and never circled back to discover what Carly actually wanted answered on the call.
